introduction: Explore the hills, help trapped miners and choose how to spend the raid camp's competing trophies. Thirteen exact deliveries remain independent. Active, ready accounting is required; confirmed rescue, personal kills, access and full campaigns require additional accepted evidence.
orientation: The northern trail connects to the Great Forest of Aravne. Ask the dwarf sentry about the mine or where, then meet Bartis and ask worried, miners and free. The mine lies beyond its ownership sign and leads to hidden refuges, a stone giant cavern and Bartis's office. A clue or a discovered zone does not prove successful travel.

A wandering stone giant carries a closed wooden box with four brown-jar declarations. Recover the jars for the two different old miners, the young miner in the well, and Bartis. Each recipient consumes one jar and retires. These quest props narrate travel home; native acceptance does not invoke a potion effect or track a village arrival.

Three distinct badge parts from the miner exchanges combine at Bartis for one complete badge. Supplied matching parts fit without earlier rescue receipts. Offer that bundle before Bartis's final jar if using the same episode; the final jar gives his note and 150000 copper, then removes him and his remaining carried sources.

Bring Bartis's exact note to the sentry for the earring; he also retires. This independent request does not verify a complete personal rescue campaign. Each accepted delivery is its own receipt, and optional producer history cannot replace spent items or restore a recipient.

The wounded dwarf takes the exact green potion inside the northern wagon, gives cash and experience, and stays. The shop's flaming green potion is different. Narrated drinking does not record a checked poison cure or a healed character.

Wandering Remi accepts the raid leader's own scalp for a staff. The raid leader instead takes six distinct proofs: four faction leaders plus Bartis and Hulkuis. Four faction requests consume the same scalps as that bundle. Spend copies deliberately; neither a receipt nor one scalp satisfies all requests.

The drow's duergar-scalp request names potion 27056 and absent item 25000. Current journal readiness cannot guarantee payout, and the request needs a builder-selected reward repair and pre-consumption loadability checks before a safe attempt. No guessed coin or experience replacement is applied.

Grab the hidden rope on the trail for its blocked western cave route. In that cave, the two same-named black stones use grab and lead to different plateaus; select the intended object carefully. Enter the stone well to reach the young miner. Say windship by the marble slab for the crypt route. These are native switch/teleport commands, not learned-topic achievements.

Examine the stone giant office desk and pull its lever for the blocked western bedroom door, then open the door. The LARGE key carried by the hill giant guard opens the separate cavern door. Room hazards, falls, one-way passages and survival need their own qualified arrival evidence; a key or clue receipt does not prove safe passage.

The bound kobold crossbow ambusher now registers periodic pulses and attacks its three nearby lanes, with four bolts per present player; loading does not fire a volley, and removal, death or movement interrupts further bolts. The separate defender/blowgun procedures are unbound and remain outside current gameplay. Combat does not record a personal quest kill.

The inn room has a real shared rent handler, the supplier has six stock kinds, and wandering A'den has shared Improved Listen teaching. Ordinary shop, lodging and skill settlement remain separate. Rare/dispersal and container/reset declarations explain possible sources without promising fresh supply or a particular encounter; branch, attempt and source-generation policies remain open.

contacts.description: Town inn. The room supports the shared rent command; Slagtooth's invitation is not a journal quest or a verified lodging journey.

contacts.name: a kobold

contacts.name: Remi Threepockets
contacts.description: Wandering Remi, initially in the outdoor dispersal source. Ask evils, evil or raid about the exact raid leader scalp; a particular encounter location is not guaranteed.

contacts.name: A'den the Bard
contacts.description: Wandering bard A'den. Shared epic teaching offers Improved Listen with an eighty-percent Listen prerequisite. Skill eligibility and settlement are separate from quest receipts.

contacts.name: a wandering stone giant
contacts.description: Wandering stone giant, initially near the mine office. Carries the closed wooden box with four brown-jar reset declarations. Open and recover the contents; the box is not itself an offering.

contacts.name: the old miner
contacts.description: First old miner in a hidden mine refuge. One jar gives badge part 27040 and 2000 experience, then retires him. Distinguish the same-named second miner.

contacts.name: the young miner
contacts.description: Young miner inside the stone well. Enter the well from the giant gathering cavern. One jar gives broken badge 27042 and 2500 experience, then retires him.

contacts.name: Hulkuis
contacts.description: Stone giant leader's office. Carries exact scalp 27058. Examine the desk for the separate pull-lever bedroom route; its use does not complete a scalp quest.

contacts.name: Bartis
contacts.description: Hidden mine office. Ask worried, miner, miners or free. Three exact badge parts give a complete badge and leave him present; a brown jar gives note and cash, then retires him. Offer badges first in the same episode.

contacts.name: a hill giant guard
contacts.description: Hill giant cavern entrance guard. Carries the LARGE key for the cavern door. Key custody does not prove unlocking or passage.

contacts.name: the old miner
contacts.description: Second old miner in the other hidden refuge. One jar gives different badge piece 27041 and 20000 experience, then retires him; this is a distinct recipient and reward.

contacts.name: the dwarf supplier
contacts.description: Town supplier. Six stock kinds include crossbow, quiver and flaming green potion; the quest's green potion is not sold here. Ordinary shop settlement is separate.

contacts.name: the raid leader
contacts.description: Raid leader's large tent. Ask worried, rook, plan or help about six exact proofs. Carries his own scalp for Remi. A supplied six-proof bundle does not establish allegiance or mine takeover.

contacts.name: the head Orc
contacts.description: Head orc's tent. Ask goblin, gumbling or mad. One goblin scalp pays cash and experience; his own orc scalp supplies a different request.

contacts.name: the head Goblin
contacts.description: Head goblin's tent. Ask orc, ponder, pondering, something or kill. One orc scalp pays cash and experience; his own scalp competes between requests.

contacts.name: the Drow leader
contacts.description: Drow leader's tent. Ask duergar. Its duergar-scalp request names missing reward item 25000 and needs repair before a safe attempt.

contacts.name: the head Duergar
contacts.description: Head duergar's tent. Ask drow, mad or bite. One drow scalp pays cash and experience; the larger bundle also consumes that scalp.
